title: Understanding the Equations
text: The equations represent the optimization problems for finding the coefficients in linear regression. The first equation is for the un-centered data, and the second is for the mean-centered data.

title: Intercept Term in Linear Regression
text: In linear regression, the intercept term represents the expected mean value of the dependent variable when all independent variables are zero.

title: Effect of Centering on Intercept
text: When data is mean-centered, the intercept term in the regression model represents the mean of the dependent variable.

title: Analyzing the Intercept Term
text: Consider how centering the data affects the intercept term in the regression model. Is the intercept term guaranteed to be positive?
